name: Ramanagara
headline: Child marriage is the main documented exit: 44 cases in 2020-2023.
summary: Ramanagara is one of the southern districts with the most recorded child marriages, 44 between 2020 and 2023, and reporting also notes rising child labour. Tracking is reactive, based on rescues and interventions rather than bridge courses for slow learners.

reasons.detail: State child-welfare data records 44 child marriages in the district between 2020 and 2023, withdrawing girls from the SSLC pipeline.
Reporting notes a rise in child-labour incidents that pull boys out of class.

The Karnataka Public School magnet pilot in Channapatna taluk folded seven village schools into Honganuru, five km from some children's earlier school; student groups say consolidation raises dropout among poor pupils.

Parents in the Channapatna pilot area worry about daughters travelling farther unaccompanied, and recalled paying about 700 rupees monthly for private transport after promised buses failed, with some keeping children home.
A 2001 study of a Ramanagaram reeling centre found about half the workforce was children under 14, while the children themselves wanted schooling; evidence is old.
A 2016 report counted 68 child marriage cases in Ramanagara over 2013-16, attributing rising statewide cases to poverty, limited education and low awareness.
